system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform action: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for livestock vaccination service authentication. For your information, my mobile_number is 9876595022, my aadhaar_number is 100020002580.

function.name: livestock_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for livestock vaccination service authentication. Does NOT verify the OTP or create a session. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile number is not registered.

function.name: livestock_track_service
function.description: Tracks the service request status for a booked vaccination. Returns service_status ('not_requested', 'requested', 'assigned', 'completed', 'failed') with assigned field worker details. Requires session_token. Does NOT administer vaccines. Fails if booking_id is invalid or no service request exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

booking_id.description: Unique identifier of the vaccination booking.
